violations.policy_section: Retail agent policy > Modify pending order > Modify items
violations.policy_clause: This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'. The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore. So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action.

violations.description: This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'. The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore. So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action.
violations.reason: In the pre-action confirmation the agent told the user 'Order status remains pending' as an unchanged protected detail, but this action is defined to change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'. The tool result after execution shows the status became 'pending (item modified)', so the action details presented before obtaining confirmation were inaccurate and omitted the required status-change consequence.
